main.description: A single watch session of one video by the repository owner. Written to the viewer's own repository so the viewer retains ownership of their engagement history. Records in a public repository are readable by anyone; clients must only write watch events the viewer has consented to publish.

subject.description: The social.openreel.video.post that was watched, pinned to the version seen.

watchDurationMs.description: Total milliseconds of playback across the session, including any rewatches. May exceed videoDurationMs.

videoDurationMs.description: Duration of the video in milliseconds at the time it was watched, so completion can be derived without hydrating the post.

soundEnabled.description: Whether audio was unmuted for at least part of the session.

rewatchCount.description: Number of times playback looped or was restarted within the session. Zero for a single pass.

context.description: Surface the video was watched from.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when the watch session ended.
